2024_169_8_b_bp_3b_award_recomendation.paragraph: Barton Malow Builders' August 20, 2024 award recommendation letter to Assistant Superintendent of Business Services Dan Trudel covers Bid Package #3B for the New Smith Middle School, with the attached bid tabulation from the July 30, 2024 public bid opening. Sixteen bid categories are recommended for award, from masonry through temperature controls, producing a total contractor direct cost of $31,554,812, a contingency at 8% of $2,524,385, and a total construction cost of $34,079,197. Barton Malow notes the project was advertised on the state website for four and a half weeks and drew 105 bids, and projects the total cost of the school, including previously awarded work and contingency, at fifty-six million dollars ($56 million).
2024_169_8_b_bp_3b_award_recomendation.page:
**What it is**
A letter dated 8/20/2024 from Josh Eisenman, Project Manager at Barton Malow Builders (26500 American Dr., Southfield, MI 48034), to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, 4420 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, recommending contract awards for BP#3B – New Smith Middle School. Bid proposals were received and read publicly on July 30, 2024. Barton Malow reviewed the proposals with the Project Architect/Engineer, TMP Architecture Inc. An attached bid tabulation (issue date 7/30/2024) lists all proposals received.

**Recommended awards**

| 3B.21 Electrical | Brenner Contracting | $3,385,000 |
| 3B.22 Fire Alarm | Brenner Contracting | $390,000 |
| 3B.26 Asphalt Paving | Nagle Paving Company | $993,990 |
| 3B.27 Temperature Controls | Mechanical Controls & Maintenance, Inc. | $1,378,100 |

**Cost summary**

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total contractor direct cost | $31,554,812 |
| Contingency (8%) | $2,524,385 |
| Total construction cost | $34,079,197 |

**Exceptions to low bid**
The low bidders in the Hard Tile and Plumbing categories did not submit a complete bid and are therefore not recommended. The second-low tile contractor, Premier Tile, and the second-low plumber, Contrast Mechanical, were interviewed and confirmed that they included all identified work; Barton Malow recommends them for award instead.

**Procurement and outlook**
The project was advertised on the state website for a total of four and a half weeks, and 105 bids were collected. The scope covers work on the New Smith Middle School not previously bid earlier in the year. An additional award recommendation is expected the following month for categories not yet interviewed, estimated at roughly twelve million dollars ($12 million). The projected total cost for the project, including work previously bid and awarded, is fifty-six million dollars ($56 million) including contingency. Additional technology and security work will be bid separately at a later date and is allocated to a budget separate from construction of the new building.

**Contact**
Josh Eisenman, (586) 651-2658, Josh.Eisenman@BartonMalow.com. Attachment: BP#3B – New Smith Middle School Bid Tabulation.

**Document and parties**
An award recommendation letter dated 8/20/2024 from Barton Malow Builders to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, 4420 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, regarding BP#3B – New Smith Middle School. The letter is signed by Josh Eisenman, Project Manager, Barton Malow Builders, whose office address is listed as 26500 American Dr., Southfield, MI 48034; his contact information is (586) 651-2658 and Josh.Eisenman@BartonMalow.com. Bid proposals were received and read publicly on July 30, 2024. Barton Malow Builders reviewed the proposals with the Project Architect/Engineer, TMP Architecture Inc., and presents the recommended companies for consideration by the administration and the Board of Education. The attachment is the BP#3B – New Smith Middle School Bid Tabulation, issue date 7/30/2024, bid opening date 7/30/2024.

**Recommended contracts by bid category**
3B.1 Masonry – Arisco Contracting Group, base bid $4,859,222, total recommended contract amount $4,859,222. 3B.2 General Trades – Graham Construction, $1,276,700. 3B.3 Carpentry – Clark Construction, $3,889,600. 3B.5 Roofing – Esko Roofing & Sheet Metal, $1,886,429. 3B.6 Aluminum Entrances – Butcher & Butcher Construction, $2,133,000. 3B.7 Hard Tile – Premier Tile Design, $383,900. 3B.8 Wood Athletic Flooring – Kuhn Specialty Flooring, $211,900. 3B.9 Flooring – Omega Floors, $935,000. 3B.17 Elevators – Kone Elevator, $107,000. 3B.18 Plumbing – Contrast Mechanical, $2,690,000. 3B.19 Fire Suppression – Absolute Fire Protection, $789,971. 3B.20 Mechanical – Bumler Mechanical, $6,245,000. 3B.21 Electrical – Brenner Contracting, $3,385,000. 3B.22 Fire Alarm – Brenner Contracting, $390,000. 3B.26 Asphalt Paving – Nagle Paving Company, $993,990. 3B.27 Temperature Controls – Mechanical Controls & Maintenance, Inc., $1,378,100.

**Cost summary as stated**
Total contractor direct cost $31,554,812; contingency (8%) $2,524,385; total construction cost $34,079,197.

**Award exceptions and procurement narrative**
The low bidders for the Hard Tile and Plumbing bid categories did not submit a complete bid and therefore are not recommended. The second-low tile contractor, Premier Tile, and the second-low plumber, Contrast Mechanical, were interviewed and have included all identified work in their bids; Barton Malow recommends them for award instead. The project was advertised on the state website for a total of four and a half weeks, and a total of 105 bids was collected. The scope includes work related to the New Smith Middle School that was not previously bid out earlier in the year. An additional recommendation will follow the next month for categories that have not yet been interviewed; based on the bid results, that next award recommendation is expected to be roughly twelve million dollars ($12 million). The projected total cost for the project, including work previously bid and awarded, is fifty-six million dollars ($56 million) including contingency. Additional technology and security work will be bid out separately at a later date, and that scope is allocated to a budget separate from the construction of the new building.
